item.title: Racing Abandoned At Leopardstown
item.description: Today's scheduled racing at the Dublin Racing Festival has been postponed following heavy rain overnight. The track had been deemed fit for racing yesterday afternoon, but was then assessed as unraceable following a further inspection this morning. The seven-race card will now take place on Bank Holiday Monday. Advertisement

item.title: Another Defeat For Munster
item.description: Munster fell to a 31-22 defeat to league leaders Glasgow Warriors in the URC last night. Second-half tries from Dan Kelly, Brian Gleeson and Diarmuid Kilgallen did ensure that the province come away from Scotland with a four-try bonus point. The Men in Red were briefly reduced to 14 players, after Thaakir Abrahams was sent to the sin-bin just before the break. Advertisement

item.title: Man trekking barefoot from Istanbul to Mayo arrives in Kerry
item.description: A man undertaking a 6000km barefoot trek from Istanbul to Mayo has arrived in the Kingdom this week. Eamonn Keaveney has traveled through Turkey, Bulgaria and Hungary completely shoe-less, raising funds for Jigsaw and Friends of the Earth. His journey began in early 2025 and has been documented on social media as "Barefoot Across Europe". Advertisement He broke the Guinness World Record for barefoot walking in September. item.title: People encouraged to familiarise themselves with urgent care options in Kerry
item.description: HSE South West is encouraging people to familiarise themselves with urgent care options available in the county. Emergency Departments typically see increased activity over bank holiday weekends, with the most seriously ill and injured prioritised. This results in increased waiting times for less-urgent cases. item.description: A Cian Brosnan hat-trick and a first ever goal from Aaran Healy have seen Kerry FC reach the Grandon's Toyota Munster Senior Cup Semi-Final. They overcame Leeds AFC 0-4 in this afternoon's Quarter-Final in Cork. Ivan Hurley reports Advertisement
